name: Major Partial-Cube Classes Are First-Order Definable with Betweenness
statement: Each listed class is definable on finite connected graphs by a fixed first-order sentence using equality and the ternary metric-betweenness relation. Consequently every listed class has a polynomial-time recognition algorithm obtained by constructing all-pairs betweenness and evaluating its fixed sentence.
comments: The generic model-checking algorithm need not output structural certificates and can have a much larger exponent than specialized recognition algorithms. Semi-median definability remains open.
